record.question: What is the role of 'radiofrequency pulses' in MRI?
options: To excite the aligned hydrogen nuclei
To generate the reversed electronic field
record.explanation: Answer A: To excite the aligned hydrogen nuclei. RF pulses excite/tilt net magnetization of aligned hydrogen nuclei. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/mri; https://cs.acr.org/-/media/ACR/Files/Radiology-Safety/MR-Safety/Manual-on-MR-Safety.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
